LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_ResonatorCore.label: Print Resonator Core
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_ResonatorCore.description: Print a resonator core on the Milira universal workbench, using a solar crystal as the resonance medium and an industrial component for the precision assembly. The resonator rig these cores are meant to feed has not been released by the Milira base mod yet, so for now a core is just a valuable piece of stock - keep it, or sell it to a trader.
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_Pawn.label: Etch Class Permit: Pawn
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_Pawn.description: Etch a Pawn-class identity chip for the Milian, using a solar crystal as the circuit medium and an industrial component as the carrier board.
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_Knight.label: Etch Class Permit: Knight
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_Knight.description: Etch a Knight-class identity chip for the Milian. As a martial class, its circuitry is denser and its carrier structure stronger.
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_Bishop.label: Etch Class Permit: Bishop
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_Bishop.description: Etch a Bishop-class identity chip for the Milian. As a psionic class, the circuitry itself carries a heavier psionic load, and so it consumes more solar crystal.
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_Rook.label: Etch Class Permit: Rook
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_Rook.description: Etch a Rook-class identity chip for the Milian. As a heavy class, its circuitry is the densest and needs the most carrier components.
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_King.label: Etch Class Permit: King
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_King.description: Etch a King-class identity chip in the solar furnace. King-class authority leans on military command, and so its chip is built around forged steel and gold.
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_Queen.label: Etch Class Permit: Queen
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_NamePlate_Queen.description: Etch a Queen-class identity chip in the solar furnace. Queen-class authority leans on divine rite and psionics, and so its chip is built around crystals and jade.
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_FurnaceCoreModel.label: Model Sunblast Furnace Core
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_FurnaceCoreModel.description: Cast a scale model of the sunblast furnace core in the solar furnace itself — the study piece from which the furnace's construction can be learned.
